verdict.rationale: HelixDB documents a generated local `dev` instance you can start and stop (docs-1, docs-15). `helix chef` scaffolds a local instance with seeded example data without any Cloud login (docs-17, gh-1), and an embedded in-memory mode is also offered (docs-2). The same queries and HTTP contract work locally and on Cloud (docs-16, docs-23), and scoped read-only keys per environment add a further guardrail (docs-11). Missing for 10: a documented Cloud-side staging or branching environment, a way to clone or snapshot production data into a sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration.
